name: Eevee & Kyoko
source:
The main character awakens in the evening out on the vast grassy plain without any memory of the self meeting Eevee and Kyoko traveling around. They insist the main character joins them on their travels, which may cause a remembrance of the past meant to be forgotten.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23203]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
傍晚，主人公在辽阔的草原上醒来，完全想不起自己是谁，并遇见了四处旅行的伊薇与基奥科。两人坚持邀请主人公加入旅程，而这趟旅行，或许会让本该被遗忘的过去再度浮现。

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23203]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
